数据表不参与运行时转换；节点 IR 只保留解释后的值及是否显式提供的标记，不携带字段路径或文档规则 ID。

## vless

### `vless.flow`

- 来源字段：`flow`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：UTF-8 shorter than 16 bytes disables flow; otherwise accept only the xtls-rprx-vision prefix.
- 目标解释：Omit flow when disabled; emit xtls-rprx-vision for Vision.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/vless.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/vless/outbound.go)。

### `vless.datagram-encoding`

- 来源字段：`packet-encoding`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：With packet-addr absent, packet/packetaddr select packet addressing; all other values and omission select XUDP.
- 目标解释：Emit packetaddr or xudp explicitly; do not depend on target defaults.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/vless.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/vless/outbound.go)。

### `vless.tls`

- 来源字段：`tls`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：The tls switch defaults to false; TLS and Reality options also influence connection setup.
- 目标解释：BoxForge requires explicit true and a supported fingerprint for Reality; otherwise reject. Emit TLS only when enabled.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/vless.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/vless/outbound.go)。

## anytls

### `anytls.tls`

- 来源字段：`tls`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Native AnyTLS always uses TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility field, not a Mihomo AnyTLS switch.
- 目标解释：Emit enabled TLS on omission or true; reject explicit false/null and unsupported Reality.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/anytls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/anytls/outbound.go)。

### `anytls.idle-timeout`

- 来源字段：`idle-session-timeout`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Mihomo declares integer seconds; BoxForge also accepts positive Go duration strings. Preserve existing rejection of zero/negative values.
- 目标解释：Emit explicit seconds with s, retain accepted duration text; omit absent/null values without inventing defaults.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/anytls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/anytls/outbound.go)。

### `anytls.idle-check-interval`

- 来源字段：`idle-session-check-interval`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Mihomo declares integer seconds; BoxForge also accepts positive Go duration strings. Preserve existing rejection of zero/negative values.
- 目标解释：Emit idle_session_check_interval using the same positive-duration interpretation as idle timeout.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/anytls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/anytls/outbound.go)。

### `anytls.minimum-idle-sessions`

- 来源字段：`min-idle-session`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Keep the accepted nonnegative int32 value, including zero; absence/null leaves runtime default handling unchanged.
- 目标解释：Emit min_idle_session when present and non-null, preserving zero.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/anytls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/anytls/outbound.go)。

### `anytls.client-metadata`

- 来源字段：`client-metadata`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Keep explicit metadata including empty strings and whitespace; BoxForge rejects LF and UTF-8 values over 65479 bytes.
- 目标解释：Emit client_metadata verbatim; omit absence/null and never invent software, version, platform or identity metadata.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/anytls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/anytls/outbound.go)。

## hysteria2

### `hysteria2.tls`

- 来源字段：`tls`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：QUIC requires TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility switch.
- 目标解释：Require TLS, reject explicit false/null, Reality and uTLS.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.ports`

- 来源字段：`ports`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Nonempty ports takes precedence over port; retain source order, scalar ports and explicit ranges.
- 目标解释：Emit server_port for one scalar; otherwise emit server_ports as start:end ranges, including equal-endpoint ranges for list scalars.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.upload`

- 来源字段：`up`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Interpret Mihomo integer bandwidth units; BoxForge additionally treats plain integers as Mbps.
- 目标解释：Keep only exact int32 Mbps values; reject rounding, truncation and source arithmetic overflow. Preserve zero and omission separately.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.download`

- 来源字段：`down`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Use the same exact bandwidth interpretation as up.
- 目标解释：Emit down_mbps without injecting a bandwidth default.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.hop-interval`

- 来源字段：`hop-interval`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Integer seconds or min-max; reorder bounds, use 30s for zero, and clamp positive minimum to 5s.
- 目标解释：Preserve fixed versus ranged intervals and int64 nanosecond bounds; leave omission to existing tuning.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.bbr-profile`

- 来源字段：`bbr-profile`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Accept standard, conservative and aggressive profiles; retain omission/null.
- 目标解释：Emit an explicit profile unchanged; existing tuning applies only when no profile and no positive bandwidth are supplied.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.obfuscation`

- 来源字段：`obfs`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Accept Salamander or Gecko and preserve the nonempty raw obfuscation password.
- 目标解释：Emit obfs only when enabled; empty/null disables it under the existing source schema.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.gecko-minimum-packet-size`

- 来源字段：`obfs-min-packet-size`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Gecko only; zero uses the core default, otherwise accept 1..2048.
- 目标解释：Keep explicit nonzero size and whether it was supplied; validate against maximum using existing 512/1200 defaults.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

### `hysteria2.gecko-maximum-packet-size`

- 来源字段：`obfs-max-packet-size`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Gecko only; use the same bounds and zero-default interpretation as minimum.
- 目标解释：Emit an explicit nonzero max_packet_size; retain whether the source supplied the field when null or zero selects defaults.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/hysteria2.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/hysteria2/outbound.go)。

## shadowsocks

### `shadowsocks.cipher`

- 来源字段：`cipher`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Keep the existing normalized cipher; BoxForge also accepts method as an exclusive alias.
- 目标解释：Emit method without adding a cipher allowlist; official check remains the target capability gate.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

### `shadowsocks.uot-enabled`

- 来源字段：`udp-over-tcp`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：UoT is opt-in; retain omission, explicit null, false and true.
- 目标解释：Emit udp_over_tcp only when enabled; do not inject a disabled object.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

### `shadowsocks.uot-version`

- 来源字段：`udp-over-tcp-version`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Omission, null and zero select legacy v1; explicit 1/2 select the corresponding wire version.
- 目标解释：Emit version 1 or 2 explicitly when UoT is enabled; reject other source versions even when disabled.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

### `shadowsocks.plugin`

- 来源字段：`plugin`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：BoxForge supports only obfs; omission, null and empty string disable it.
- 目标解释：Emit obfs-local with structured, validated options lowered to SIP003 text; v2ray-plugin remains rejected.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

### `shadowsocks.obfs-mode`

- 来源字段：`mode`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：BoxForge requires an explicit http or tls obfs mode.
- 目标解释：Emit obfs=http or obfs=tls; do not store SIP003 text in the node IR.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

### `shadowsocks.obfs-host`

- 来源字段：`host`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Omission/null uses bing.com; keep explicit raw text and reject blank/control-character hosts.
- 目标解释：SIP003-escape backslash, semicolon and equals only during emission, preserving source text in IR.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/shadowsocks.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/shadowsocks/outbound.go)。

## trojan

### `trojan.tls`

- 来源字段：`tls`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Native TCP Trojan always uses TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility field, not a Mihomo Trojan switch.
- 目标解释：Emit enabled TLS on omission or explicit true; BoxForge rejects explicit false or null.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/protocol/trojan/outbound.go)。

## tls

### `tls.server-name`

- 来源字段：`sni`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Use the supplied TLS name, falling back to server; BoxForge also accepts servername and preserves its existing trimming.
- 目标解释：Emit the interpreted name as server_name, including the server fallback.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/std_client.go)。

### `tls.certificate-validation`

- 来源字段：`skip-cert-verify`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Explicit true disables certificate validation; false enables it. Preserve omission separately.
- 目标解释：Emit the explicit boolean as insecure; leave omitted/null values unset.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/std_client.go)。

### `tls.application-protocols`

- 来源字段：`alpn`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：Keep explicit protocol order and duplicates, and distinguish omission from an empty list.
- 目标解释：Preserve the existing alpn values and omission/empty-list serialization; this migration does not change defaults.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/std_client.go)。

### `tls.client-fingerprint`

- 来源字段：`client-fingerprint`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：BoxForge accepts its existing shared modern profiles; empty/none selects native TLS. Other profiles remain rejected.
- 目标解释：Emit supported uTLS profiles; omit utls for native TLS.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/component/tls/utls.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/utls_client.go)。

### `tls.reality.public-key`

- 来源字段：`public-key`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：BoxForge accepts a 32-byte Base64URL Reality public key; keep the accepted key unchanged.
- 目标解释：Emit the accepted key as reality.public_key.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/reality_client.go)。

### `tls.reality.short-id`

- 来源字段：`short-id`；状态：`Mapped`。
- 来源解释：BoxForge accepts zero to eight bytes of even-length hexadecimal, preserving case after existing trimming.
- 目标解释：Emit the accepted value as reality.short_id, including an explicitly empty string.
- 固定源码：[来源](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/blob/88dcbf7f1614a67c3b36b848ee3592dfa92ada36/adapter/outbound/trojan.go)、[目标](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/blob/b609f959f57ce34416c51c7b87ce4a76f2e1df56/common/tls/reality_client.go)。
